fix_commit_msg:
fpga/common: Fix FIFO status connections

Signed-off-by: Alex Forencich <alex@alexforencich.com>
description:
fpga/common: Fix FIFO status connections

Signed-off-by: Alex Forencich <alex@alexforencich.com>
rtl_diff:
diff --git a/fpga/common/rtl/rx_fifo.v b/fpga/common/rtl/rx_fifo.v
index 8a8dca6c..df918899 100644
--- a/fpga/common/rtl/rx_fifo.v
+++ b/fpga/common/rtl/rx_fifo.v
@@ -174,9 +174,9 @@ for (n = 0; n < PORTS; n = n + 1) begin : fifo
         .m_axis_tuser(axis_fifo_tuser[n*USER_WIDTH +: USER_WIDTH]),
 
         // Status
-        .status_overflow(status_overflow),
-        .status_bad_frame(status_bad_frame),
-        .status_good_frame(status_good_frame)
+        .status_overflow(status_overflow[n]),
+        .status_bad_frame(status_bad_frame[n]),
+        .status_good_frame(status_good_frame[n])
     );
 
 end
diff --git a/fpga/common/rtl/tx_fifo.v b/fpga/common/rtl/tx_fifo.v
index 9d6612ff..f809e5a1 100644
--- a/fpga/common/rtl/tx_fifo.v
+++ b/fpga/common/rtl/tx_fifo.v
@@ -232,9 +232,9 @@ for (n = 0; n < PORTS; n = n + 1) begin : fifo
         .m_axis_tuser(m_axis_tuser[n*USER_WIDTH +: USER_WIDTH]),
 
         // Status
-        .status_overflow(status_overflow),
-        .status_bad_frame(status_bad_frame),
-        .status_good_frame(status_good_frame)
+        .status_overflow(status_overflow[n]),
+        .status_bad_frame(status_bad_frame[n]),
+        .status_good_frame(status_good_frame[n])
     );
 
 end
